title: Discovery of a novel mutation F184S (c.551T>C) in GATA4 gene causing congenital heart disease in a consanguineous Saudi family.
authors: Rasool, Mahmood; Pushparaj, Peter Natesan; Haque, Absarul; Shorbaji, Ayat Mohammed; Mira, Loubna Siraj; Bakhashab, Sherin; Alama, Mohamed Nabil; Farooq, Muhammad; Karim, Sajjad; Larsen, Lars Allan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过全外显子测序发现GATA4转录因子F184S突变，并用AlphaFold同源建模和Missense3D等工具预测其DNA结合功能受损，虽涉及TF-DNA互作但方法以序列变异注释和简单结构评估为主，缺乏深入的结合建模或AI/物理模拟机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIM: Congenital heart disease (CHD) is the most common cause of non-infectious deaths in infants worldwide. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying CHD remain unclear. Approximately 30 % of the causes are believed to be genetic mutations and chromosomal abnormalities. In this study, we aimed to identify the genetic causes of CHD in consanguineous families. METHODS: Fourth-generation pedigrees with CHD were recruited. The main cardiac features of the patient included absence of the right pulmonary artery and a large dilated left pulmonary artery. To determine the underlying genetic cause, whole-exome sequencing was performed and subsequently confirmed using Sanger sequencing and different online databases to study the pathogenesis of the identified gene mutation. An in-silico homology model was created using the Alphafold homology model structure of GATA4 (AF-P43694-F1). The missense3D online program was used to evaluate the structural alterations. RESULTS: We identified a deleterious mutation c.551T > C (p.Phe184Ser) in GATA4. GATA4 is a highly conserved zinc-finger transcription factor, and its continuous expression is essential for cardiogenesis during embryogenesis. The in-silico model suggested a compromised binding efficiency with other proteins. Several variant interpretation algorithms indicated that the F184S missense variant in GATA4 is damaging, whereas HOPE analysis indicated the functional impairment of DNA binding of transcription factors and zinc-ion binding activities of GATA4. CONCLUSION: The variant identified in GATA4 appears to cause recessive CHD in the family. In silico analysis suggested that this variant was damaging and caused multiple structural and functional aberrations. This study may support prenatal screening of the fetus in this family to prevent diseases in new generations.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：先天性心脏病（CHD）是全球婴儿非感染性死亡的最常见原因。然而，CHD 的分子机制仍不清楚。约 30% 的病因被认为是由基因突变和染色体异常引起。本研究旨在鉴定近亲家庭中 CHD 的遗传病因。方法：招募了患有 CHD 的第四代家系。患者的主要心脏特征包括右肺动脉缺失和左肺动脉显著扩张。为确定潜在的遗传病因，进行了全外显子组测序，并随后通过 Sanger 测序及多个在线数据库确认，以研究所鉴定基因突变的发病机制。使用 GATA4 的 AlphaFold 同源模型结构（AF-P43694-F1）创建了计算机同源模型。利用 missense3D 在线程序评估结构改变。结果：我们在 GATA4 中鉴定出一个有害突变 c.551T > C（p.Phe184Ser）。GATA4 是一个高度保守的锌指转录因子，其持续表达对胚胎发生过程中的心脏发生至关重要。计算机模型提示其与其他蛋白质的结合效率受损。多种变异解读算法表明，GATA4 中的 F184S 错义变异具有破坏性，而 HOPE 分析则显示该变异导致转录因子 DNA 结合功能及 GATA4 锌离子结合活性受损。结论：在 GATA4 中鉴定的变异似乎在该家系中导致隐性 CHD。计算机分析表明该变异具有破坏性，并引起多种结构和功能异常。本研究可能支持该家系中胎儿的产前筛查，以预防新生代疾病。
